channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Supporting returnees remains top priority for IEA: Hanif
item.description: Minister of Economy Qari Din Mohammad Hanif has stated that addressing the challenges faced by returnees remains a top priority for the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan (IEA).

item.title: Over 537m old banknotes set ablaze in Herat
item.description: Da Afghanistan Bank (DAB) has burned about 537,746,000 old afghani banknotes in Herat province.

item.title: Jimmy Lai, Hong Kong media tycoon, gets 20-year prison sentence

item.title: First green garnet mine discovered in Panjsher
item.description: A new green garnet mine has been discovered in Anaba district of central Panjsher province for the first time, an official said on Monday.

item.title: UAE provides 65 types of medicines to Jawzjan hospital
item.description: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has donated 65 types of medicines worth $150,000 to the 200-bed provincial hospital in northern Jawzjan province, aiming to address critical shortages of essential medical supplies.

item.title: Over 1,750 detained while crossing Herat border illegally
item.description: Security forces in western Herat province have detained more than 1,700 individuals over the past week who were attempting to leave the country illegally through smuggling routes.

item.title: Identical twins’ DNA match complicates French murder case
item.description: Identical twin brothers on trial for murder in France have complicated the case, as investigators are unable to determine which of them fired a weapon due to their identical DNA, a media report said on Monday.

item.title: OIC, Germany envoys discuss Afghanistan situation
item.description: The Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) mission in Kabul announced that its ambassador met with the Chargé d’Affaires of the German Embassy to discuss recent developments in Afghanistan, including security, humanitarian and economic conditions and political challenges.

item.title: ICC confirms Pakistan-India match in T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) has confirmed that Pakistan will participate in all of their scheduled matches at the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, including the much-anticipated clash against India on February 15 in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

item.title: 2 killed, 4 wounded in Ghazni traffic accident
item.description: Two people have been killed and four others injured in a traffic accident in southern Ghazni province, police said on Tuesday.
